title: Which product specifications should be used to verify the output of a twin-strip stainless-steel annealing furnace?
summary: Suneng's 2022 dual-strip continuous stainless-steel annealing furnace documents give a design output of 34.37 t/h for two strips in one furnace, with specified steel grade, dimensions and speed. Final acceptance separately specifies continuous-production trials using two SUS304 strip sizes. Distinguish the design-calculation material, actual acceptance-test sizes and whether output is counted per strip, per dual-strip furnace or across two furnaces.
